title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice Prizm #82 T.J. Warren Indiana Pacers Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Enhance your basketball card collection with this 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice Prizm #82 T.J. Warren trading card. Featuring T.J. Warren of the Indiana Pacers, this sports trading card is perfect for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and the sport of basketball. The card is part of the base set and comes with a parallel/variety feature, adding to its uniqueness.

Manufactured by Panini, this card is a must-have for any basketball enthusiast and collector. It is not autographed, but its rarity and color make it a valuable addition to any collection. Get your hands on this incredible card and elevate your collection to the next level.
